name: Polar
source:
Quarterback of the football team at Dream Savior Gakuen. Despite his jockish appearance, Polar values intelligence over force and is very kind. He decides to help you raise money for a school event.

[From [url=https://soulsoftea.itch.io/dsg-redraw]itch.io[/url].]
